notes.title: Patch v.1.0.5 available
notes.content:
Patch v.1.0.5 is now available. This will be the last update of the year and includes some minor bug fixes and tweaks.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed camera movement randomly freezing.
[*] Decreased chance of acquiring timer reset bonus.
[*] Reset the highscores tables to give new players a chance.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and have a happy new year!

tags.balance_change: [*] Decreased chance of acquiring timer reset bonus.

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.4 available
notes.content:
Patch v.1.0.4 is now available. This is a small patch which includes some minor bugfixes and tweaks.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a glitch where collected keys bonus time deduction reset to 59 when minutes was at zero - in arcade mode.
[*] UI elements optimization.
[*] Highscore backend fixes.
[*] AI optimizations.
[*] Reduced player move speed.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch v.1.0.2 available
notes.content:
Patch v.1.0.2 is now available. This is a small patch which includes some minor bugfixes and improvements to address some of the player feedback.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased monster spawn distance.
[*] Reduced flickering/popping graphical artifacts.
[*] Backend optimizations.
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added music volume slider setting.
[*] Added grace period after monster spawns.
[*] Added arrow keys move input (in addition to WASD).
[/list]

Thank you for playing!
